dialogs.about: 며느리와 함께 김치를 담그며 재료를 챙기는 이야기

lines.en: Today we will make kimchi together.
Yes, Mother. What should I wash first?
Please wash the cabbage. I will cut garlic.
lines.ko: 배추를 씻어 주세요. 저는 마늘을 썰게요.

lines.en: Do we need ginger and red pepper too?
Yes. Ginger makes the taste much better.
lines.ko: 네. 생강이 맛을 훨씬 좋게 해요.

lines.en: How much pepper did you use?
I used two cups last year.
Then this kimchi will be very spicy.
lines.ko: 그러면 이 김치는 아주 매울 거예요.

lines.en: Let it ferment for five days.
Thank you, Mother. I will remember this.

dialogs.about: 시장에서 두부와 김을 사며 가게 주인과 이야기

lines.en: Hello. Is this tofu fresh today?
Yes, it arrived this morning.
Good. I will take two packs of tofu.
Do you need seaweed? It is very cheap.
Yes, please give me one bag of seaweed.
Here you are. Do you make soup often?
I made seaweed soup for my son yesterday.
That is nice. We have fresh garlic too.
Then I will take garlic and soy sauce.
Thank you. Please come again soon.
